summary: Specifies optional suites of algorithms and attributes that simplify the administration of IPsec, whether used with manual keying, IKEv1, or IKEv2. Since two IPsec systems must use the same algorithms to interoperate, preset suites reduce configuration. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Instead of picking every ingredient, you order a combo meal. These are ready-made combos of secret-keeping methods.
